## Section affected

Which section(s) of SPEC.md?

## Current text

Quote the text as-drafted.

## Proposed text

Your proposed replacement.

## Rationale

Why is the current text insufficient? What breaks or is unclear without this change?

## Backwards compatibility

Is this change backwards-compatible with v0.1 as currently drafted? If not, is it appropriate for v0.1 (still an RFC), or should it target v0.2?

## Tested against

Have you tested this change against any implementation? If so, which?
